title: Mazauna Lambunan Biyu
intro: A cikin ƙasar da albarka ke kwarara sosai, wata al'umma ta taɓa jin daɗin yalwar lambuna biyu masu ban mamaki. Rayuwarsu shaida ce ta alherin Allah, duk da haka labarinsu ya sauya lokacin da godiya ta ragu, wanda ya haifar da canji wanda zai zama alama mai ɗorewa ga duk wanda ya yi tunani.
clues: Mu mutane ne masu albarka da ƙasar jin daɗi da wadata.
Ubangijinmu ya ba mu gonaki biyu masu kyau, masu kyau da albarka a kowane gefe.
An umarce mu da mu gode, amma muka zaɓi rashin godiya muka juya baya.
Babban madatsar ruwa ya riƙe ruwan da ya ba ƙasarmu rai.
Da muka dage kan aikata laifinmu, sai madatsar ruwa ta fashe kuma ruwan ya ratsa ta.
An maye gurbin lambunanmu masu cike da 'ya'yan itace masu ɗaci, tamarisk, da wasu bishiyoyin lote.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Iska mai ƙarfi ta tsawon dare bakwai
Ambaliyar ruwa daga fashewar madatsar ruwa
trial.answer: Ambaliyar ruwa daga fashewar madatsar ruwa

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An maye gurbin lambunanmu da 'ya'yan itatuwa masu ɗaci da kuma bishiyoyi marasa yawa
Ƙasa ta haɗiye mu a girgizar ƙasa
An rikide mu zuwa birai da aladu
An nutsar da mu cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai girma
outcome.answer: An maye gurbin lambunanmu da 'ya'yan itatuwa masu ɗaci da kuma bishiyoyi marasa yawa

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
